acip: TING NGE 'DZIN 'DI BRDZUN PAR TE LOG PA'I DON YID LA BYED PAR YANG MI 'GYUR RO,,
english: Neither is it the case that this meditative concentration would be deceptive; which is to say, you would not be directing your mind towards something mistaken.
